members.name: trigger
members.doc: The focusable element that opens the Popover. Pressing it toggles the Popover.

members.name: open
members.doc: Whether the Popover is open, when the caller controls it.

members.name: defaultOpen
members.doc: Whether the Popover starts open, when it controls itself.

members.name: dismissable
members.doc: Whether Escape, an outside press, and the trigger close the Popover. When false, only a button in the close slot closes it, in modal and non-modal mode alike.

members.name: placement
members.doc: Where the Popover opens against its trigger or anchorRef. start and end follow the locale direction.

members.name: offset
members.doc: The distance in pixels between the Popover and its trigger, along the placement's side.

members.name: crossOffset
members.doc: The shift in pixels along the side the Popover is placed against.

members.name: shouldFlip
members.doc: Whether the Popover moves to the opposite side when the placed side has no room.

members.name: containerPadding
members.doc: The least distance in pixels between the Popover and the edge of the viewport. Must not be negative.

members.name: modal
members.doc: Whether the Popover contains focus until it closes. When false, it is non-blocking: it has no focus containment, outside-content exclusion, or scroll locking.

members.name: colorScheme
members.doc: Makes the open Popover a scope of this color scheme, whatever the page's. Its surface is that scheme's raised popup surface, not the strong surface an unscoped Popover has, and its text and any Mux UI component inside follow the scheme. Unset leaves the Popover as the page styles it. A scoped Popover also carries the data-muxui-theme and data-muxui-contrast of its trigger's nearest scope, or of the document root, and follows them while it is open.

members.name: onOpenChange
members.doc: Reports the Popover opening or closing.
